mapper.select: SELECT c.policy_number, c.insured_name, c.insured_contact, c.contract_start_date, c.contract_end_date, c.contract_status, COALESCE(c.insured_amount, p.insured_amount) AS insured_amount, COALESCE(c.maturity_refund_amount, p.maturity_refund, 0) AS maturity_refund_amount, (c.contract_end_date - CURRENT_DATE)::BIGINT AS days_until_maturity, CASE WHEN c.contract_end_date <= CURRENT_DATE THEN 'DUE' ELSE 'UPCOMING' END AS maturity_timing, n.sent_at AS notice_sent_at, n.renewal_intention, n.renewal_checked_at FROM contract c LEFT JOIN product p ON p.product_code = c.product_code LEFT JOIN contract_maturity_notice n ON n.policy_number = c.policy_number WHERE c.contract_status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.contract_end_date <= #{targetEndDate} ORDER BY c.contract_end_date, c.policy_number

SELECT c.policy_number, c.insured_name, c.insured_contact, c.contract_start_date, c.contract_end_date, c.contract_status, COALESCE(c.insured_amount, p.insured_amount) AS insured_amount, COALESCE(c.maturity_refund_amount, p.maturity_refund, 0) AS maturity_refund_amount, (c.contract_end_date - CURRENT_DATE)::BIGINT AS days_until_maturity, CASE WHEN c.contract_end_date <= CURRENT_DATE THEN 'DUE' ELSE 'UPCOMING' END AS maturity_timing, n.sent_at AS notice_sent_at, n.renewal_intention, n.renewal_checked_at FROM contract c LEFT JOIN product p ON p.product_code = c.product_code JOIN contract_maturity_notice n ON n.policy_number = c.policy_number WHERE c.contract_status IN ('ACTIVE', 'MATURED') AND c.contract_end_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND n.renewal_intention IS NULL ORDER BY c.contract_end_date, c.policy_number
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO contract_maturity_notice ( notice_id, policy_number, delivery_method, notice_message, sent_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{noticeId}, #{policyNumber}, #{deliveryMethod}, #{noticeMessage}, #{sentAt}, #{createdAt} ) ON CONFLICT (policy_number) DO UPDATE SET delivery_method = EXCLUDED.delivery_method, notice_message = EXCLUDED.notice_message, sent_at = EXCLUDED.sent_at
